contexts.text: Wretched () = him who thinks without coherence concerning the things of the Church. (Explained.)

And knowest not that thou art wretched = that they do not know that their falsities have no coherence with truths. Calamity = the breaking of truths by means of falsities, and also no coherence. Illustrated.
The loss of all understanding of truth is meant by mischief shall fall upon thee ().
Falsity from falsity is meant by calamity upon calamity ().
Their inward part is calamity (). Here also calamity = falsities not cohering with any truth.
